camel_example: aliyun live AddLiveAppRecordConfig --region cn-hangzhou --OssEndpoint 'oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com' --DomainName 'example.com' --OssBucket liveBucket0000 --AppName liveApp0000
description_en: Configures recording for an application and saves the output to Object Storage Service (OSS)
description_zh: 配置APP录制，输出内容保存到OSS中
kebab_example: aliyun live add-live-app-record-config --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --oss-endpoint oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com --oss-bucket liveBucket0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddLiveAppRecordConfig

parameters.help_en: The streaming domain of the streamer
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the stream belongs. The template takes effect only when the AppName value matches the AppName in the ingest URL. To match all application names, set this parameter to an asterisk (*)
parameters.help_zh: 播流所属应用名称。AppName名称与推流地址中的AppName名称对应，模板才能生效。若不限制AppName可填*，即可匹配所有AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint of the OSS bucket.

To store live recordings in OSS, create an OSS bucket in advance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84932.html
parameters.help_zh:
OSS存储的Endpoint名称。

直播录制文件存储至OSS，需提前创建OSS Bucket，创建方法请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84932.html
parameters.name: oss_endpoint

parameters.help_en:
The name of the OSS bucket.

To store live recordings in OSS, create an OSS bucket in advance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84932.html
parameters.help_zh:
OSS存储的Bucket名称。

直播录制文件存储至OSS，需提前创建OSS Bucket，创建方法请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84932.html
parameters.name: oss_bucket

parameters.help_en: The stream name. The template takes effect only when the StreamName value matches the StreamName in the ingest URL. To match all stream names under the specified AppName, set this parameter to an asterisk (*)
parameters.help_zh: 播流名称。StreamName名称与推流地址中的StreamName名称对应，模板才能生效。若不限制StreamName可填*，即可匹配AppName下所有StreamName
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en: The recording start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC). The specified time must be within 7 days of the actual stream ingest start time. This parameter is valid only for stream-level recording (when StreamName is not empty)
parameters.help_zh: 录制开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 设置的时间必须是实际推流时间开始7天之内，只在流级别录制（StreamName不为空）有效
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The recording end time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC). The difference between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 7 days. If it exceeds 7 days, the value is calculated as 7 days. This parameter is valid only for stream-level recording (when StreamName is not empty)
parameters.help_zh: 录制结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 EndTime与StartTime相差不应超过7天，超过7天将按照7天计算。只在流级别录制（StreamName不为空）有效
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The on-demand or manual recording mode. Valid values:

0 (default): disabled. Automatic recording is used.
1: on-demand recording through HTTP callback. You must first configure OnDemandUrl by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847891.html operation. Otherwise, recording is not performed by default.
2: on-demand recording by parsing stream ingest parameters.
7: manual recording. Recording is not performed by default. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847882.html operation to manually start or stop recording
parameters.help_zh:
按需/手动录制。取值：

0(默认值)：关闭，即自动录制。
1：按需录制，通过HTTP回调方式。需要先通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847891.html接口配置OnDemandUrl，否则默认不录制。
2：按需录制，通过解析推流参数。
7：手动录制，默认不录制，可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847882.html接口手动控制录制开启或停止
parameters.name: on_demand

parameters.help_en: The stream discontinuity merging duration. If the live stream is disconnected for longer than the specified merging duration, a new file is generated. Valid values: 15 to 21600. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh:
断流拼接时长。
直播断流时长超过设定的拼接时长后，将会生成新文件，断流拼接时长支持15~21600秒
parameters.name: delay_time

fields.help_en:
The recording length per epoch. Unit: seconds.

If this parameter is not specified, the default value varies by recording format: 6 hours for m3u8 and cmaf formats, and 1 hour for flv and mp4 formats.
If a live stream is disconnected within a recording epoch but resumes stream ingest within the stream discontinuity merging duration, recording continues in the same file. This is Normal behavior.
A recording file is generated only after the live stream is disconnected for longer than the stream discontinuity merging duration
fields.help_zh:
周期录制时长。单位：秒。

若不填则取默认值，不同录制格式的默认值不同：m3u8、cmaf 格式默认6小时，flv、mp4格式默认1小时。
如果在一个录制周期内，直播流发生了断流，但是在断流拼接时长内，该直播流又正常推流，那么仍会在同一个录制文件中继续录制。
一条直播流必须断流超过断流拼接时长，才会生成录制文件
fields.name: cycle_duration

fields.help_en:
The format. M3U8, FLV, MP4, and CMAF are supported. Valid values:

<notice>At least one of RecordFormat and TranscodeRecordFormat must be set. If you select m3u8 or cmaf, you must also set the request parameters RecordFormat.N.SliceOssObjectPrefix and RecordFormat.N.SliceDuration.
</notice>

m3u8.
flv.
mp4.
cmaf.

Settings for RecordFormat and TranscodeRecordFormat: at least one must be specified
fields.help_zh:
格式。目前支持M3U8、FLV、MP4、CMAF。取值：

<notice>RecordFormat和TranscodeRecordFormat两者至少需要设置一个。如果选择m3u8或cmaf格式，必须同时设置请求参数RecordFormat.N.SliceOssObjectPrefix和RecordFormat.N.SliceDuration。
</notice>

m3u8。
flv。
mp4。
cmaf
fields.name: format
oss_object_prefix

fields.help_en:
The segment length of a single segment. Unit: seconds.

<notice>This parameter takes effect only when RecordFormat.N.Format is set to m3u8 or cmaf.
</notice>

If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 30 seconds. Valid values: 5 to 30
fields.help_zh:
单个切片时长。单位：秒。

<notice>当RecordFormat.N.Format（格式）设为m3u8或cmaf时，本参数才有效。
</notice>

不填则默认为30秒。取值范围：5s~30s
fields.name: slice_duration

fields.help_en:
The segment name.

<notice>This parameter is required only when RecordFormat.N.Format is set to m3u8 or cmaf.
</notice>

The default segment length is 30 seconds. The value must be less than 256 bytes and supports variable matching, including {AppName}, {StreamName}, {UnixTimestamp}, and {Sequence}.
The value must contain the {UnixTimestamp} and {Sequence} variables
fields.help_zh:
切片名称。

<notice>当RecordFormat.N.Format（格式）设为m3u8或cmaf时，本参数才需要配置。
</notice>

默认30秒一片，小于256字节，支持变量匹配，包含{AppName}、{StreamName}、{UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}。
参数值必须包含{UnixTimestamp}和{Sequence}变量
fields.name: slice_oss_object_prefix

fields.help_en:
The recording length per epoch for transcoding stream recording. Unit: seconds.

fields.help_zh:
